Hi Lara —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. We're excited to get the kickstart scheduled and want to confirm the right attendees and a compact agenda so we can send the calendar invite. A couple of notes up front: we typically keep the initial session to 60–75 minutes (intro, access checks, an implementation plan outline, and immediate next steps).

Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?

- Primary goals for the first session (quick list)
- Who from SkyCare will join (names + roles + timezones) — we saw you added Samir; any additional technical folks?
- Do you prefer a 60 minute hands-on session or a 75 minute walkthrough with Q&A?

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Wed Jul 23: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15
- Thu Jul 24: 10:30–11:45 or 15:00–16:15

If none of those work, tell me two preferred times and your timezone and I’ll coordinate. We’ll include a short runbook and a meeting bridge (dial-in + Zoom). I attached a draft SOW and a kickoff agenda template so you can see the proposed topics.

Attachments: [Attachment: SkyCare-SOW-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [Attachment: Kickstart-Agenda-template.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed slots until I hear back.

—Jordan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
